text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's so biiiig! ♪
This is my first time doing anything like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁぁ、
おっきーい♪
アカリ、
こんなの初めて……！

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text: The Tower of Luna, huh... It sure does look impressive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔かぁ……
凄いところに来ちゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text: So... This place holds the key to your memories, does it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
あそこにアンタの記憶の鍵があるのね？

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? \"Probably\"?
Sheesh, that doesn't exactly inspire confidence!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
たぶん？　
なによ、
ハッキリしないんだから……

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what am I saying?!
That was the perfect time to say \"Leave this to us!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
そうじゃなくて！
ここは私たちに任せなさい
って言うところなのにー！

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm such an idiot...
We might be able to find his lost memories here.
This is my chance to finally repay him for all the attention he's given me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
私のばか……
記憶喪失のアイツの手掛かりがあるんだもん。
今まで
こんな人見知りの私に構ってくれた分、
恩返ししないと！

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Why can I never seem to say these things properly...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう。
でも、
全然ちゃんと伝えられなかった……

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: Hee hee. Looks like Yori is really trying to do her best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
お姉ちゃん、
やる気十分って感じ♪

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
I hope this adventure lets her convey her feelings
and thank him properly like she's always wanted to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この冒険でお姉ちゃんが、
ちゃんとお兄ちゃんに、
いつもありがとう
って気持ちを
伝えられますように！

text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do our best today, {0}, Yori!
I'm sure it'll be a really stimulating experience! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉーし、
頑張りましょうね、
お兄ちゃん、
お姉ちゃん！
一緒に刺激的な経験が
できるといいな♪
